detail.en:
Each jelly capsule surrounds an embryo. Only a small part of a clutch is represented here. [S2]

This independently enlarged observation is not a count of eggs laid by a particular frog. [S22]
detail.zh:
每个胶质包被围着一个胚胎。这里仅画卵团的一小部分。[S2]

这个观察标本独立放大，不表示某种青蛙一次产卵的数量。[S22]

detail.en:
The rounded body joins a tapering tail and thin tail membrane. This selected free-swimming view has no visible legs and no feathery external gills. [S2, S3]

It is a young frog, not a fish. Some other frogs develop differently; this is a general pond-frog example. [S3, S5, S22]
detail.zh:
圆胖的身体连着逐渐变细的尾巴和薄尾膜。所选的自由游泳视图不画可见的腿或羽状外鳃。[S2, S3]

它是青蛙的幼体，不是鱼。有些蛙的发育方式不同；这里画的是通用池塘型青蛙的例子。[S3, S5, S22]

detail.en:
Two hind legs are visible beside the tail. The front legs are not yet visible in this chosen observation. [S2, S3]

Each model hind foot has five toes. The stage is a snapshot of continuous change, not a fixed number of days. [S20, S22]
detail.zh:
尾巴两旁各能看到一条后腿。这个观察视图还没有可见的前腿。[S2, S3]

模型每只后足有五趾。它是连续变化中的一个观察画面，不代表固定的发育天数。[S20, S22]

name.zh: 尾巴尚未吸收完的幼蛙

summary.zh: 显示仍连着身体的短尾

detail.en:
Four limbs support a frog-shaped body while the tail remains attached. During metamorphosis the tail tissues are remodelled and absorbed; the tail does not break off. [S2, S4]

The model keeps four fingers on each forefoot and five toes on each hind foot. Its tail length is an observation choice, not an age measurement. [S20, S22]
detail.zh:
身体已经呈蛙形，四肢出现，短尾仍与身体相连。变态发育时尾部组织重塑并吸收，不是尾巴断掉。[S2, S4]

模型每只前足保留四指，每只后足五趾。所画尾长只是观察选择，不是日龄测量。[S20, S22]

detail.en:
The broad head, short forelimbs and folded hind limbs show a tailless adult form. It has four fingers on each forefoot and five toes on each hind foot. [S2, S20]

This original generic specimen is not an identification of a Singapore species. The next-generation link means reproduction; this adult never turns into an egg. [S12, S15, S22]
detail.zh:
宽扁的头、短前肢和屈曲后肢呈现无尾的成体形态。每只前足四指，每只后足五趾。[S2, S20]

这个原创通用标本不用于鉴定新加坡蛙种。通向下一代的连接表示繁殖；成蛙不会变回卵。[S12, S15, S22]

detail.en:
A hard shell encloses the albumen, yolk and other structures. The model leaves most of the shell in place when its separate window opens. [S6, S7]

The shell is hollow geometry, not a solid egg hidden with X-ray. Its thickness, size and cut are teaching choices. [S22]
detail.zh:
坚硬的蛋壳包住卵白、卵黄等结构。独立壳窗打开时，其余蛋壳仍留在原位。[S6, S7]

模型蛋壳是有壁厚的空壳，不靠 X 光模式隐藏一个实心卵。壁厚、显示大小和切口都是教学设计。[S22]

detail.en:
This complementary shell sector fits the remaining shell when closed. The reveal control lifts it away, exposing a genuine opening toward the egg close-up camera. [S22]

This is a teaching cut. Natural hatching is a chick opening and leaving the shell, not this neat removable sector. [S6, S22]
detail.zh:
闭合时，这片壳与其余蛋壳合成完整外壳。打开控件把它移开，形成朝向近看镜头的真实开口。[S22]

这是讲解用的切口。自然孵出是雏鸡打开蛋壳并离开卵，不会切下这样整齐的壳片。[S6, S22]

detail.en:
The yolk supplies nourishment to a developing embryo. It is represented by a separate rounded body inside the egg. [S6, S7]

The embryo lies beside its surface in this schematic example; it is not a miniature chick hidden at the centre of the yolk. [S6, S22]
detail.zh:
卵黄为发育中的胚胎提供营养。模型把它画成卵内独立的圆形结构。[S6, S7]

这个示意例子的胚胎位于卵黄表面旁，不是藏在卵黄中心的缩小雏鸡。[S6, S22]

detail.en:
The albumen surrounds the yolk. It contains water and protein and is separate from the yolk and embryo. [S7]

The pale translucent envelope is schematic; the model omits the shell membranes, air cell and chalazae rather than inventing their positions. [S7, S22]
detail.zh:
卵白围着卵黄，含水分和蛋白质，与卵黄及胚胎是不同结构。[S7]

浅色透明包络仅作示意。模型省略壳膜、气室和卵黄系带，不虚构它们的位置。[S7, S22]

summary.zh: 显示发育中胚胎的例子

detail.en:
A curved small body sits beside the yolk in this developing fertilised-egg example. No exact incubation age is assigned to this schematic outline. [S6, S22]

The embryo is shown only when the window is open and the fertilised example is chosen. A closed view merely conceals it; warmth does not fertilise an unfertilised egg. [S6, S9, S22]
detail.zh:
小而弯曲的身体位于卵黄旁，表示一个正在发育的受精卵例子。此轮廓不对应精确的孵化日龄。[S6, S22]

只有打开壳窗并选择受精例子时才显示胚胎。闭合只是遮住内部；温暖不会使未受精卵受精。[S6, S9, S22]

detail.en:
A short beak, rounded down-covered body, two wings and two feet identify a young bird. It grows into an adult chicken without a pupa stage. [S6, S9]

The independently enlarged specimen has simplified down and proportionally short tail feathers. It is not the adult model scaled down. [S22]
detail.zh:
短喙、圆胖的绒羽身体、两翅和两足呈现幼鸟的形态。它逐渐长成成鸡，不经过蛹期。[S6, S9]

标本独立放大，简化绒羽并保留较短尾羽。它不是把成鸡等比例缩小。[S22]

detail.en:
The broad breast, feathered wings, small comb and short tail show a domestic hen. A cock is also an adult chicken, but this model uses a hen as its example. [S9, S22]

The chick and hen share the bird body form but differ in proportions and feathers. This is not a field guide to Singapore domestic fowl or Red Junglefowl. [S11, S22]
detail.zh:
丰满的胸部、带羽毛的翅、小鸡冠和短尾呈现家鸡母鸡。公鸡也属于成鸡；这个模型选择母鸡作为例子。[S9, S22]

雏鸡和母鸡都具有鸟类身体形态，比例与羽毛却不同。本图不用于野外区分新加坡家鸡与红原鸡。[S11, S22]

detail.en:
The small bead and thin ring are display marks, not organisms or a clock. The control moves the marker between fixed observations; the specimens remain in place. [S22]

Moving back to an earlier observation means inspecting it again, not reversing biological development. [S15, S22]
detail.zh:
小珠和细环是展台标记，不是生物或时钟。控件让标记移到预定观察位置，标本本身留在原位。[S22]

切回较早的观察表示重新查看，不表示生物发育可以倒转。[S15, S22]

detail.en:
The small bead and thin ring are display marks, not organisms or a clock. The control moves the marker between fixed observations; the specimens remain in place. [S22]

Moving back to an earlier observation means inspecting it again, not reversing biological development. [S15, S22]

切回较早的观察表示重新查看，不表示生物发育可以倒转。[S15, S22]

detail.en:
Read the jelly-coated egg, tadpole, hind-leg tadpole, froglet with tail and adult. The tail is still attached in the froglet; there is no pupa. [S2, S3]

These tiny silhouettes omit digits. The main frog tray shows four fingers and five toes on the corresponding feet. Every stage is enlarged independently; spaces do not measure time. [S20, S22]
detail.zh:
依次观察胶质包被的卵、蝌蚪、长出后腿的蝌蚪、带尾幼蛙和成蛙。幼蛙尾巴仍相连，没有蛹期。[S2, S3]

微型轮廓省略指趾细节；主青蛙展台呈现前足四指、后足五趾。各阶段分别放大，间距不代表时间。[S20, S22]

detail.en:
The chicken comparison shows an egg, a small downy chick and an adult hen. The chick is a young bird, with no intervening pupa. [S6, S9]

Each model is independently enlarged. This row shows order only; it does not compare how long stages take or how large they really are. [S22]
detail.zh:
鸡的对照展示卵、绒羽雏鸡和成年母鸡。雏鸡是幼鸟，中间没有蛹期。[S6, S9]

各模型分别放大。这一排只显示顺序，不比较各阶段持续时间或实际大小。[S22]

detail.en:
The four silhouettes represent egg, larva, comma-shaped pupa and six-legged adult. Mosquito larvae and pupae develop in water; the pupa precedes the emerging adult. [S14]

These are independently enlarged silhouettes, not a frog sequence. The main mosquito topic explains its water stages in detail. [S13, S14, S22]
detail.zh:
四个轮廓分别表示卵、幼虫、逗号形的蛹和六足成虫。蚊子的幼虫与蛹在水中发育，之后成虫羽化。[S14]

这些是分别放大的蚊子轮廓，不是青蛙的阶段。蚊子主题详细讲述水中阶段。[S13, S14, S22]

summary.en: Compares seed, young and adult plant

detail.en:
The plant row uses a seed, a young plant and an adult flowering plant. The seed is not called an egg. [S1]

This is an abbreviated comparison, with independent sizes and no common timescale. Pollination, fruit and seed dispersal belong to the linked plant topic. [S21, S22]
detail.zh:
植物一排用种子、幼株和开花成株进行比较。种子不称为卵。[S1]

这是简化对照，大小分别设定，也没有共同时间尺度。传粉、果实和种子传播由链接的植物主题展开。[S21, S22]

detail.en:
The small bead and thin ring are display marks, not organisms or a clock. The control moves the marker between fixed observations; the specimens remain in place. [S22]

Moving back to an earlier observation means inspecting it again, not reversing biological development. [S15, S22]
detail.zh:
小珠和细环是展台标记，不是生物或时钟。控件让标记移到预定观察位置，标本本身留在原位。[S22]

切回较早的观察表示重新查看，不表示生物发育可以倒转。[S15, S22]

detail.en:
The final link connects an adult with eggs of a new generation. It does not show the same adult shrinking back into an egg. [S15]

The arrow is a static diagram mark. Equal spacing and reversing an observation control do not mean equal durations or reversible development. [S22]
detail.zh:
最后的连接把成体与下一代的卵联系起来，不表示同一个成体缩回卵中。[S15]

箭头是静态图示。等距摆放或反向拨动观察控件，都不表示时间相等或发育可以倒转。[S22]

detail.en:
The final link connects an adult with eggs of a new generation. It does not show the same adult shrinking back into an egg. [S15]

The arrow is a static diagram mark. Equal spacing and reversing an observation control do not mean equal durations or reversible development. [S22]
detail.zh:
最后的连接把成体与下一代的卵联系起来，不表示同一个成体缩回卵中。[S15]

箭头是静态图示。等距摆放或反向拨动观察控件，都不表示时间相等或发育可以倒转。[S22]

summary.zh: 承托各自独立的观察标本

detail.en: This low display tray is a diagram support, not a simulated habitat. Static arrows show reading order only. Sizes are independently enlarged and spacing is not time. [S22]
detail.zh: 低矮展台只是图示支撑，不是生境仿真。静态箭头只表示阅读顺序。标本分别放大，间距不代表时间。[S22]

summary.zh: 承托各自独立的观察标本

detail.en: This low display tray is a diagram support, not a simulated habitat. Static arrows show reading order only. Sizes are independently enlarged and spacing is not time. [S22]
detail.zh: 低矮展台只是图示支撑，不是生境仿真。静态箭头只表示阅读顺序。标本分别放大，间距不代表时间。[S22]

summary.zh: 承托各自设定大小的对照

detail.en: Four separate specimen groups sit on a low tray. No common physical scale or developmental timescale is implied. [S22]
detail.zh: 四组独立标本摆在低矮展台上，不表示共同的实际比例或发育时间尺度。[S22]

value.zh: 观察模型，不是发育预测

label.zh: 尾巴尚未吸收完的幼蛙

froglet.zh: 尾巴尚未吸收完的幼蛙

label.zh: 是否显示发育中的胚胎

hidden.en: No embryo shown in this view

fertilised.en: Fertilised; suitable incubation is also needed
fertilised.zh: 已经受精；还需要适宜的孵化条件

unfertilised.en: Unfertilised; warmth does not fertilise it
unfertilised.zh: 没有受精；温暖不会使它受精
